'''Josa Kenn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Kenn worked for [[Hedrett Shipping and Investments]] as a crewmember of the ''[[Fricasseed Nerf]]'', a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he was aboard the ship when it collided with a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] fragement in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and was left drifting in space. However, he and the rest of the crew of the ''Nerf'' were rescued by the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
